in_marathi.name: Anvitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Grace, beauty, compassion
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anvitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anvitha is a Sanskrit name meaning 'one who embodies grace, beauty, and compassion'. In Hindu mythology, Anvitha is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, who represents knowledge, learning, and wisdom.
